Power for AI.
Flexibility for the Grid.

Emerald AI makes AI’s power demand flexible, transforming data centers into valuable grid
partners, protecting energy affordability and reliability for local communities, and unlocking
massive capacity on existing grid infrastructure to power the AI revolution today.

What if the biggest new user of electricity–AI–could become the grid’s greatest ally?

AI flexibility can unlock 100GW to power the AI revolution today

Temporal AI flexibility

Briefly slow or pause batchable AI workloads when the grid is stressed and resume post‑event, all within SLA guardrails.

Spatial AI flexibility

Shift workloads across regions on fiber to where power is abundant — within latency bounds.

Resource flexibility

Dispatch batteries and other onsite energy alongside compute orchestration for maximum, reliable flexibility.

Academic Rigor at Commercial Scale

Emerald AI has deployed power flexibility at commercial data centers around the world, validating
the results with partners, customers, and top scientific journals.

ARIZONA · 2025

First peer-reviewed proof of AI power flexibility

During peak grid demand on a hot Phoenix afternoon, Emerald Conductor flexes down AI power demand at an Oracle data center by 25% over three hours to meet the utilities needs.

PLATFORM: NVIDIA A100 · PARTNERS: EPRI, ORACLE, NVIDIA, SRP, DATABRICKS

UNITED KINGDOM · 2025

Beating the tea-kettle surge

When football halftime hits, a gigawatt of tea kettles switches on. Emerald Conductor shaved power to ease national grid kettle spikes and met 200 power targets overall with 100% compliance.

PLATFORM: NVIDIA B300 · PARTNERS: EPRI, NEBIUS, NVIDIA, NATIONAL GRID

VIRGINIA ↔ CHICAGO · 2026

Shifting load across the map

During Virginia's winter peak, Emerald geo-shifted inference traffic within milliseconds from a constrained Virginia site to a Chicago site with available capacity — ensuring inference was served within latency constraints.

PLATFORM: NVIDIA H100 · PARTNERS: EPRI, ORACLE, NVIDIA, COMMONWEALTH EDISON, PJM

OREGON · 2026

Full-stack economic dispatch under extreme weather

Deploying on NVIDIA Grace Blackwell Ultra clusters, Emerald Conductor shaved power against volatile market pricing signals and sustained multi-day load reductions through heat dome and freezing rain stress events.

PLATFORM: NVIDIA GB300 · PARTNERS: EPRI, PORTLAND GENERAL ELECTRIC, NVIDIA

CALIFORNIA · 2026

Counteracting the California Duck Curve

Emerald's first multi-MW, full data center deployment cut power use during peak California CAISO demand on a hot summer day, reducing load after sunset when solar generation goes dark.

PLATFORM: NVIDIA H100

VIRGINIA · 2026

The World's First Power-Flexible AI Data Center

Emerald AI partners with NVIDIA and Digital Realty to launch a 96MW Vera Rubin AI Factory in Manassas, Virginia, that sets a new reference architecture for power-flexible AI infrastructure built on the NVIDIA DSX Platform.

PLATFORM: NVIDIA VERA RUBIN · PARTNERS: NVIDIA, DIGITAL REALTY, EPRI, PJM, DOMINION

The Infrastructure Behind the Infrastructure

Emerald Conductor is the flexibility management platform for AI infrastructure. We connect
utilities and data centers in real time, simulate a digital twin model of AI power, orchestrate
compute alongside onsite energy, and verify performance—so AI can grow in harmony with
stronger, more affordable grids.

Connect grids & data centers

Provide operators with AI demand visibility and enable data centers to respond to grid signals.

Orchestrate AI workloads & onsite energy

Flexibly control power use, meeting grid needs while preserving AI performance.

Optimize across data center fleets

Orchestrate spatiotemporal workload flexibility to support grids nationwide.

Verify performance

Auditable M&V data and automated reporting, establishing data centers as credible grid resources.

Connecting the Ecosystem That's Powering the AI Revolution

For data center developers & operators

Get to 'Power-On' in Months, Not Years. Accelerate your interconnection queue, upsize an existing connection, and turn your energy consumption into a monetizable asset. We make your facility a preferred partner for any utility.

02

For utilities & operators

Integrate the Future, Safely. Transform the largest new source of demand into your most valuable flexible resource. Gain unprecedented visibility, accurate forecasting, and dispatchable load to enhance grid stability and defer costly infrastructure upgrades.

03

For AI innovators & cloud providers

Scale Without Constraint. Never let power availability dictate the pace of your innovation. Our platform ensures you have swift access to the energy you need to train and deploy the world's most advanced models, while assuring stringent AI performance standards.

04

Enable Innovation, Ensure Reliability, Protect Affordability. Accelerate the AI economic boom while strengthening grid resilience and protecting ratepayers. Our platform provides a powerful, market-based tool to manage new demand efficiently, achieving policy goals without relying solely on costly and slow-to-build infrastructure.
